title: Cut Silence by shash.builds
summary: Cuts silences and umm or uh fillers from a face recording or voice-over with ffmpeg, keeping a 0.15 s pad. Free, local, no API key.
cover_line: Silences and umms out of your recording, speech left untouched.
result: 7.0 s to 3.5 s: 1 cut (2 silences, 1 filler)
